verdict.rationale: cubic automatically reviews new pull requests once installed (cubic-docs-4, cubic-docs-41) and comments on bugs and improvements (cubic-docs-25). Several features make that feedback contextual: codebase-aware chat (cubic-docs-10), learnings drawn from senior reviewers' past comments (cubic-docs-40), custom standards agents (cubic-docs-34), and re-review after force-push (cubic-docs-2). A hands-on user reports the reviews are quieter and more useful (cubic-comm-7), and another notes cubic contextualizes the app better than other tools (cubic-comm-1). Missing for 10: strong independent evidence on comment quality and accuracy, and PRs opened before install need a manual trigger (cubic-docs-5).
